Anatomy

  1. 1.dr-card__linkAn empty link stretched over the whole card (inset: 0, z-index 1), named for the order: Package delivery, in progress — view details. The buttons stand above it at z-index 2.
  2. 2.dr-order__headThe name over the date, first in the DOM. Title 15/600 in --text-primary; date in the meta step, --text-muted, ellipsised on one line.
  3. 3.dr-wellThe drone doing the job, a 96 × 96 cutout with no ground, closing the row on the right.
  4. 4.dr-statusThe status indicator: a 20px disc on the well's top-right corner with a 2px card-coloured cutout ring.
  5. 5.dr-railThe four-step progress rail, at step 2: .dr-rail--at2 sets --dr-fill to 25%. Live orders only.
  6. 6.dr-insetThe From ▸ To strip: --bg-inset, radius 12, padding 16, a 26px neutral direction chip between the stops.
  7. 7.dr-order__feeThe fee as a .dr-number (20/700, tabular) with its word in .sr-only, and the ETA chip beside it.
  8. 8.dr-btn--primaryView details, a link in .dr-card__actions, the screen's one green control, on the live card only.

The card's stretched .dr-card__link, cut to the head and well. From order-history.

When to use

The order card is the record of one order in a list: order-history (one live card and three delivered) and order-history-loading (three skeleton cards) on the client side, and operator-listings on the operator side, where the same card is a job. There the top row closes with a chip (New, In progress) instead of a well, the strip reads Pickup ▸ Drop-off, and the actions are Accept and Decline side by side, or Continue. It is the most measured component in the product. The name leads and the well closes the row, so the reading order and the screen-reader order are the same sequence (WCAG 1.3.2): Package delivery · Today 10:03 · In progress.

The status is never carried by the mark alone. Live green is 1.52:1 on the card and does not clear WCAG 1.4.11 by itself; the live card is also the only one with a rail, an ETA chip and the green CTA, and the mark says In progress outright. Shape and behaviour separate live from done, never colour alone.

The title is the service, not the drone. The fee is a figure with its word in .sr-only, the CTA is the canonical View details, and the icon actions take their name from aria-label (Delete order, View details). Client side it is an order, operator side a job; the words never cross.

One live order and one delivered, 28 apart on a list that is the screen. The live card spends the screen's one green control; the delivered card answers with grey icon actions. This is the top of order-history.

Don’t

Package delivery 28 Jun · 14:20
Accepted
En route
On-site
Done

A delivered order with a rail of four ticked nodes and a green CTA. Four ticks say nothing and cost 60px, and the green spends a second primary on a list that already has a live order. Drop the rail and use the delivered shape. To make a whole card one tap target instead of carrying a button, use the card that is one link.
